basic_info.description: Experience coastal elegance in the heart of San Francisco's Outer Sunset. Just steps from Ocean Beach and the vibrant surf scene, this classic 1950s Tunnel Entry residence seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern convenience. The main home features 2 spacious bedrooms, a full bath with a separate tub and shower, original parquet hardwood floors, an inviting breakfast nook, and updated lighting that enhances its warm character.    The lower level offers a rare, fully legal 1-bedroom apartment with a large eat-in kitchen and direct access to an expansive, sun-soaked flat yard - perfect for entertaining, relaxation, or play.    Ideally located near acclaimed schools, lush parks, boutique shops, beloved eateries, and effortless Muni access, this property delivers both investment opportunity and lifestyle luxury in one of San Francisco's most desirable coastal communities. Join us and discover why this Sunset gem is the perfect place to call home.
